name: How much does a home addition typically cost in Orange County?

mainEntity.name: How much does a home addition typically cost in Orange County?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of a home addition in Orange County varies significantly based on several factors, including the size and complexity of the project, the materials chosen, and the specific finishes. A basic room addition can start from around $150-$250 per square foot, but more complex projects, such as a multi-story addition or one involving significant plumbing and electrical work, can exceed $400 per square foot. These figures are estimates and do not include potential architectural plans, engineering, or permit fees, which are additional considerations.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs for home additions in Orange County typically range from $150-$400+ per square foot, depending on project complexity, materials, and finishes.
